ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 40% high-intensity (yellowish-white) pixels distributed in lateral lobe regions and 60% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central axial region and outer margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, irregular, high-intensity contiguous blobs occupying the lateral portions of both lobes. The central region is a solid low-intensity black mass that extends vertically to the median notch. Small, low-intensity circular spots are sparsely scattered within the high-intensity lateral zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a well-defined central apex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular frequency of peaks and valleys along the trailing boundary. The left lobe exhibits low-amplitude micro-serrations, while the medial trailing edge of the right lobe shows high-amplitude, jagged indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the proximal/leading edges tapering to acute, slightly recurved fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several small, roughly circular dark pixel clusters within the high-intensity regions, specifically visible in the upper-mid sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions including a diagonal mark in the lower quadrant of the left lobe and horizontal scratches in the outer quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular notch or trauma-induced indentation located on the medial portion of the right lobe's trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-tan hue visible across all high-intensity fluke regions, indicative of biological surface film (diatoms) rather than pure white pigmentation.
